newsitem.title: SWEDEN: S&P gives Sweden Landshypotek A- longterm rating.
newsitem.headline: S&P gives Sweden Landshypotek A- longterm rating.

text.p: U.S. credit rating agency Standard & Poor's on Thursday said it had assigned Sweden's Landshypotek an A- long-term counterparty rating.
It assigned the unlisted mortgage bank an A-2 rating for its short-term counterparty rating.
The outlook was stable, S&P said in a statement.

"The ratings reflect Landshypotek's strong market position in the provision of secured longterm finance to the Swedish agricultural sector, its satisfactory capitalisation and improving asset quality and profitability," S&P said in a statement.

Landshypotek is the largest provider of mortgage finance to the agricultural sector in Sweden, a position enhanced last year with an agreement with Foreningsbanken AB to acquire its Jordsbrukskredit, since renamed Landshypotek Jordsbrukskredit.

S&P said Landshypotek's improved financial strength would bolster its capitalisation through profit retentions and this offsets somewhat the concerns that the agency has in regards to the company's ability to raise core capital.
"Going forward, however, low credit demand and increased competition are likely to lead to lower margins on new lending and a reduction in Landshypotek's financial flexibility," S&P said.
